note: Hand-derived from canonicalS3ExternalPrincipalGrantUpsertCypherFormat (go/internal/storage/cypher/cloud/aws/s3/external_principal_grant_writer.go): `MATCH (source:CloudResource {uid: row.source_uid}) MERGE (principal:ExternalPrincipal {uid: row.principal_uid}) ... MERGE (source)-[rel:%s]->(principal)`. The one %s fills from the closed single-member vocabulary screened per row by validateS3ExternalPrincipalGrantRelationshipType, so GRANTS_ACCESS_TO is the only type this writer can emit. Each source is a reducer.cloudjoin.CloudResourceUID value = sha256 over account_id, region, resource_type, resource_id: account_id 123456789012 and region us-east-1 everywhere, with (resource_type, resource_id) pairs (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::orders-artifacts), (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::shared-reads), and (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::logs-archive). Each target is the stable ExternalPrincipal uid folding principal kind and value. Exactly four edges sorted by (source, principal): orders-artifacts to aws_account 222233334444 (cross_account, resolved by name), shared-reads to aws_service logging.s3.amazonaws.com (service_delivery, resolved by name), shared-reads to aws_account 333344445555 (cross_account, source name derived from the ARN tail with a blank bucket_name), and logs-archive to public * (public, resolved by name). The other three grants contribute nothing on purpose -- one naming unscanned ghost-bucket (source_unresolved), one with unprojectable principal kind unsupported (unsupported_principal), and one with blank principal kind and value (missing_identity, which still decodes so it reaches the skip rather than quarantine). The idle bucket scans as a node but carries no grant. The MERGE keys on its two endpoint nodes alone, so there is no identity block; grant_outcome and resolution_mode are SET after the MERGE and are asserted as mutable properties instead.
